The first four CI runs found SIX defects the local gate satisfies by accident: (1) pytest -m 'not integration' deselected ALL 1418 tests and asserted nothing - an unscoped conftest hook; (2) the real-browser-profile guard was a no-op on Linux, the platform the browser agent runs on; (3+4) two Windows agent tests asserted the host's ELEVATION, not the policy (an elevated token owns new objects as BUILTIN\Administrators, which ServiceMode trusts); (5) a working-directory test compared path SPELLINGS (8.3 short path vs long); (6) the M6 self-healing E2E hardcoded taskkill so it had never run on Linux, the supervisor's production platform. Recurring pattern, named in DECISIONS.md: a guard or recovery path verified only on the platform it does NOT run on.
